'''Betty''' (Japanese: '''バッキー''' ''Bakkie'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]''. She is the sister of [[Angus]] and [[Getty]].

She and her brothers are infamous for their wild antics throughout the [[Unova]] region. They all entered the [[Clubsplosion]] tournament together, where she eventually faced off against Getty in ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'' and won. 

In ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]'', Betty battled {{Ash}} in the second round. Betty took aim at {{AP|Scraggy}}'s apparent weakness and misfired {{m|Focus Blast}}. However, she became increasingly frustrated with her {{p|Simipour}} as the battle waged on, often shouting out attacks. Despite her brothers cheering her on, she and Simipour were defeated by Ash's Scraggy.
